bundle.shortDescription: Local pentest workspace: from recon to report
bundle.longDescription: Bring Nmap, Burp and Nuclei results into one local project. Connect infrastructure, findings and evidence, recover editor drafts, record retests and build Markdown, HTML or evidence-bundle reports. Open-source MVP for authorized assessments.
